finding: nofreadp and nofreads are local integer accumulators never initialized before addition. All occurrences are their declaration, accumulation and diagnostic writes in ACTUALSTATIONS; they do not enter the inversion equations. Native summary P/S totals can be garbage. Own input-token and per-ray counts are used instead.
interpretation: Not evidence that the valid per-station phase counts or actual input ray arrays were corrupted; numerical sensitivity remains separately assessed.
